titulo: Quiz — One table, one bill, one goodnight
subtitulo: The bread, the round, the list on the wall and the way out
introPt: Two travellers get through a whole evening — a table outside, a local glass and one bill — without a single surprise.
cenario: A pavement table outside an ouzeri, half past ten, the plates arriving in the middle.

dialogo.es: Καλησπέρα! Έξω ή μέσα; Το ψωμί είναι ένα ευρώ το άτομο, το θέλετε;
dialogo.pt: Good evening! Outside or inside? The bread is one euro a head — do you want it?
dialogo.tts: Καλησπέρα! Έξω ή μέσα; Το ψωμί είναι ένα ευρώ το άτομο, το θέλετε;

dialogo.es: Έξω, παρακαλώ. Ναι στο ψωμί. Τι έχετε ντόπιο;
dialogo.pt: Outside, please. Yes to the bread. What do you have that's local?
dialogo.tts: Έξω, παρακαλώ. Ναι στο ψωμί. Τι έχετε ντόπιο;

dialogo.es: Ρακόμελο και τσίπουρο. Οι τιμές είναι στον τιμοκατάλογο, στην είσοδο.
dialogo.pt: Rakomelo and tsipouro. The prices are on the list, at the entrance.
dialogo.tts: Ρακόμελο και τσίπουρο. Οι τιμές είναι στον τιμοκατάλογο, στην είσοδο.

dialogo.es: Δύο ρακόμελο. Κερνάω εγώ. Πόσο κάνει όλα μαζί;
dialogo.pt: Two rakomelo. This one's on me. How much is it all together?
dialogo.tts: Δύο ρακόμελο. Κερνάω εγώ. Πόσο κάνει όλα μαζί;

perguntas.pergunta: Bread arrives at the table before you have ordered. What is the rule?
opcoes: It is always free
It may be charged only if it was offered and you accepted
It is a cover charge and it is normal
It is charged per table, never per person
perguntas.explica: A cover charge is prohibited outright, and no item — bread and bottled water named explicitly — may be served and billed without prior consent, at €500 per item. Offered and accepted, bread is a perfectly lawful line.

perguntas.pergunta: Where do you find what the evening will cost before you sit down?
opcoes: You ask the waiter, there is no list
On the price list, in Greek, at the entrance and again before you order
Only on the bill at the end
On the board only in tourist areas
perguntas.explica: The list is compulsory, in Greek, visible at the entrance and before ordering, VAT included — €1,000 if it is missing, €500 for any item billed above the listed price.

perguntas.pergunta: Somebody waves your money away and pays for the whole table. Best move?
opcoes: Insist until he takes it
Thank him and get the next round in
Leave the money on the table anyway
Work out your share and transfer it later
perguntas.explica: The round is the unit, not the individual drink. Taking the next one is the second half of the same gesture — arithmetic at one in the morning is not.

opcoes: Exactly ten per cent
Fifteen per cent, as at home
There is no standard percentage — rounding up is a complete answer
Nothing, tipping does not exist here
perguntas.explica: Greek tax law recognises tips — up to €300 a month per worker is exempt from income tax — which confirms they exist and are normal. No defensible national percentage exists.

perguntas.pergunta: You have a boat at seven and the table is staying out. How do you leave?
opcoes: Slip away quietly so nobody breaks up the evening
Say you are going, say goodnight, and go
Wait until everybody else stands up
Announce that the evening is over
perguntas.explica: Leaving is announced, not performed. «Εγώ φεύγω. Καληνύχτα!» ends your night without ending anybody else's, and «Τα λέμε αύριο» leaves the door open.
